headline: Solventum (SOLV) Appoints Neil Zieselman As New Chief Accounting Officer
summary: Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) has appointed Neil Zieselman as Senior Vice President, Controller, and Chief Accounting Officer. He will succeed current Controller and Chief Accounting Officer Mary Wilcox following her retirement. Zieselman brings experience from Surgery Partners Inc., Stryker Corporation, Covanta Holding Corporation, Cendant Corporation, and Avaya Inc., and is a licensed CPA.
